fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 今天我要说说一个刺青的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about a tattoo story.

fullTextZH: 刺青就是画在身上的图。
fullTextEN: A tattoo is a picture on the body.
It will always, always be there.
Because it cannot be washed off,

fullTextZH: 所以刺青之前你要想好。
fullTextEN: so before getting a tattoo, you need to think carefully.

fullTextZH: 很难的事里面也会有好的一面。
fullTextEN: Even in difficult things, there is a good side.
For example, if a person gets sick,

fullTextZH: 发现他有很多家人、朋友爱他、
fullTextEN: he discovers he has many family members and friends who love him,

fullTextZH: 帮他，这是他健康的时候没有发现的。
fullTextEN: Help him, this was something he didn't discover when he was healthy.

fullTextZH: 为什么我有这个刺青呢？
fullTextEN: Why do I have this tattoo?

fullTextZH: 因为以前我有一个男朋友，
fullTextEN: Because I used to have a boyfriend,

fullTextZH: 有一次他想要一个新的刺青，
fullTextEN: Once he wanted a new tattoo,
I want to go together too."

fullTextZH: 我想要这个阿拉伯文的刺青。
我的男朋友看到，他觉得："哦，
fullTextEN: My boyfriend saw it, he thought: "Oh,

fullTextEN: He also wanted an Arabic tattoo.

fullTextZH: 所以他请我帮他写阿拉伯文。
fullTextEN: So he asked me to write in Arabic for him.
I asked him: "What do you want to write?"
So I helped him write it,

fullTextZH: 然后我们两个人一起去刺青，
fullTextEN: Then the two of us went to get tattoos together,

fullTextZH: 后来我发现这个男生他有两个女朋友。
fullTextEN: Later, I found out that this guy had two girlfriends.

fullTextZH: 他请我写阿拉伯文的时候，
fullTextEN: When he asked me to write in Arabic,

fullTextZH: 这样他就有很奇怪的刺青——"爱臭豆腐"。
fullTextEN: So he would have a very strange tattoo—"love stinky tofu".
When she sees people with tattoos,

fullTextZH: 绝对、绝对不可以去刺青！"
所以我每次回家的时候，我要很小心，
fullTextEN: So every time I go home, I have to be very careful,
I can't let her see it.

fullTextZH: 你猜我妈妈知道我有刺青吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think my mom knows I have a tattoo?

fullTextZH: 有7年的时间她都不知道。
所以那一天我的妈妈都不跟我说话。
fullTextEN: So that day my mom didn't talk to me.
Now when I go back to Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 中文有一句话："身体发肤，受之父母。"
fullTextEN: In Chinese, there's a saying: "Our body, hair, and skin are given by our parents."

fullTextZH: 意思是：我们的头发、皮肤、
身体都是爸爸妈妈给的。
fullTextEN: and body are all given by our parents.

fullTextZH: 所以我们要好好的爱自己。
fullTextEN: So we should love ourselves well.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈也觉得我的身体是她给我的，
fullTextEN: My mom also thinks my body was given to me by her,
so I can't get a tattoo.
What do you think, do you agree?

fullTextZH: 在台湾，老一点的人不喜欢刺青。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, older people don't like tattoos.

fullTextZH: 因为以前的台湾只有坏人会刺青。
fullTextEN: Because in the past, only bad people in Taiwan had tattoos.

fullTextZH: 所以如果他们看到一个人有刺青，
fullTextEN: So if they see someone with a tattoo,

fullTextZH: 他们会觉得这个人可能是坏人。
fullTextEN: they might think this person could be bad.

fullTextZH: 在台湾，有些老板看到有人刺青，
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, some employers see tattoos,
and don't want to give them a job.

fullTextZH: 比如学校或银行这种地方，
fullTextEN: For example, places like schools or banks,

fullTextZH: 他们特别不喜欢看到刺青。
fullTextEN: they especially don't like seeing tattoos.

fullTextZH: 所以有些人找工作的时候要盖住刺青。
fullTextEN: So some people cover their tattoos when job hunting.

fullTextZH: 好，这就是我的刺青故事。
大家看到刺青的感觉是什么呢？
fullTextEN: what do people feel when they see tattoos?
